integrity: The infinite tail is handled by a structural density lemma. Exact finite enumeration is used only to replay the bounded rank-0/rank-1 cases for representative widths; the all-n multiplicities are proved symbolically from the order definition.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the canonical family X_n^*. It does not determine the exact two-generated spectra. Originality risk remains for unindexed folklore because the uniform argument is short once the X_2 calculation is recognized.
title: Uniform monogenic rigidity in the canonical strictly finite Heyting family
